description: The CAREGIVERS table contains information about caregivers, linking unique caregiver IDs (CGID) to job titles or roles. The table includes a shortened label for the role and a more detailed description. Each row is uniquely identified by ROW_ID.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the dataset.

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: Shortened job title or category for a caregiver.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Full job title or role description for a caregiver.
